# Wenku8 Flutter Fork: repository instructions

Before editing, read [the shared project guide](../.agents/PROJECT_GUIDE.md). It defines current local-reader scope, user-data safety, public-source policy, CI commands, and PR acceptance.

Use the domain-specific `SKILL.md` in [`.agents/skills`](../.agents/skills) when work touches UI, local-library state, Android CI, public-source gaps, book import, reader rendering or image export.

Do not assume upstream-only features are available in this Fork. Protect original books, reading state and bookmarks; respect `tools/public-source-files.txt` and `tools/check_public_source.py`. Report which checks actually ran and which need a device.
